claim: On breast_cancer's declared 5-fold split (569 rows, every row held out exactly once; majority 0.6316), local_goodness with its declared target channel (credit.readout_error=True) beats gradient by more than +0.005 fold-mean val_acc at L2/20 on the same digital/feedforward/instantaneous/null/adam cell, paired over seeds 67-71
protocol: TODO92 section 3.8. Screening input: section 3.13 measured local_goodness +0.0158 val_acc over gradient on a single 114-row breast_cancer holdout (resolution 0.88 pp), so the effect was about 1.8 held-out rows and could not carry a claim. This run replaces the single holdout with the task's own declared split: TabularTask.fold_indices(5), stratified, random_state=0, every one of the 569 rows held out exactly once, fold-mean resolution 1/569 = 0.18 pp. Instrument: computronium.evaluation.base.cross_validate, which drives the same SystemTrainer the kernel uses over the task's folds; the system is composed by compose_cell_system at the same coordinate as the section 3.13 cells (digital/feedforward/instantaneous/null/gradient-or-local_goodness/adam, geometry.hidden_dim=256), only the credit, its declared channel and the seed differ. Viability ladder for local_goodness was run in section 3.11 (legal completion, above chance at its best ladder point, declared readout_error channel), so rungs 0-2 are on record and this is a rung-3 claim. Decision: the 95% bootstrap CI of the paired per-seed fold-mean difference lies strictly above +0.005 with permutation p < 0.05 (computronium.validation.preregistration.ThresholdRegistration / PairedComparison.passes). Error costs: a false PASS promotes a credit whose section 3.13 advantage was 114-row noise, and spends the next run on a composition that does not hold; a false FAIL retires a live credit on one coarse coordinate, which the plan answers with the reversal trigger in section 3.13, never with tuning. Stop rule: if the CI does not clear the threshold, the tabular advantage becomes a coordinate result, section 3.13's reversal trigger fires and the stop-loss is re-evaluated from the published map; do not tune lr, do not add seeds, do not switch tasks. No pilot seed is a registered seed (pilot uses seed 42, fold 0, 1 epoch, excluded from the paired decision).
